patterns.note: Full-width sections with content consistently centered and constrained, creating clear visual breaks between different topics.
Speaker and schedule sections utilize a responsive grid of distinct cards, each with a subtle border and rounded corners for individual content items.
A dominant light blue (#78a0d9) serves as the primary background color, providing a consistent brand presence and contrasting with white and dark text for readability.
The main navigation header remains sticky at the top of the viewport, ensuring continuous access to site navigation as the user scrolls down the page.
Content sections, including the detailed 3D illustration in the hero, simply appear as they scroll into the viewport without explicit fade-in or slide-up animations.
Clear, distinct content sections are visually separated by alternating full-width background colors (light blue and white) and generous vertical padding.

technique_notes: The header is implemented as a sticky element that remains fixed at the top of the viewport, providing persistent navigation. No detected animation tech is used for its transformation.
Sections are structured with generous vertical padding and full-width background colors that alternate between the primary blue and white, creating clear visual separation.
The hero section features a large, whimsical 3D illustration that is initially below the fold and becomes fully visible as the user scrolls down, serving as a visual anchor for the event.

design_tokens.type_scale: A bold, oversized hero heading (~4x body) sets a strong initial impression, followed by distinct, bold section headings (~2x body) and clear, readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) are consistently applied to buttons, cards, and elements within the 3D illustration.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with significant vertical padding between main sections and a more compact grid for content cards like speakers and schedule.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a playful, detailed 3D illustration in the hero section, which contrasts with the otherwise clean and functional layout, gives a unique and memorable personality to a technical conference.
